_note: Hand-verified boundary labels for resources/3 min Clips/mainvideo.mp4.
Each entry was judged from a full-size frame 0.5s either side of the
timestamp. Do not label from small thumbnails or a shorter gap: three of
these were first labelled from 200px frames 0.25s apart and got it wrong,
which made the detector look like it had to choose between missing cuts
and splitting shots in half. It does not.
cuts       : a real cut - different place, subject, or camera setup
same_scene : one continuous shot in which something merely moved
Add to these rather than replacing them. The suite reports precision and
recall against whatever is here, so a bigger set is a stricter test.
Second round: the suite reported 10 of the detector's own boundaries as
unlabelled, which meant half its output was ungraded - the same gap that
hid the first bug. All 10 were judged from full-size pairs and added, and
the false-split count went from 2 of 19 to 7 of 24. The number did not
get worse; the measurement got honest. 168.57s is the least certain of
them: the camera swings from a trailer to a van in half a second and the
vision check reads it as a cut.
